term: actually existing with esse distinct from essence (q.3 a.4 model)
definition: DistinctEsseAt p x is InAct x p.esse together with p.esseOf x ≠ p.essenceOf x, both functions taking values in the same Principle sort. This is a typed identity test, not a full theory of individuation or of the act of being.
note: Reuses the existing Aquinas-oriented InAct, esse, essenceOf and esseOf interface for a source-scope test, with actual existence included explicitly to avoid conditional claims about merely possible candidate beings.
